# Pipeline report totals round once

<!-- part: status -->
Status: released on 18 November 2026 [r3]

<!-- part: summary -->
The pipeline report total now adds the exact amounts and rounds once, to two decimals. [r1]

<!-- part: changes -->
Before, the total could be off by a few dollars on a report with many deals under a dollar apart. [r2]
